name: Wind-Rain Bridge
description: Fengyu Bridge is a type of bridge with various forms, but most of them are pavilion-type structures. It generally consists of a bridge, a tower, and a pavilion. The bridge deck is paved, with railings and benches on both sides, and the bridge roof is covered with tiles to form a promenade. Because pedestrians can avoid wind and rain, it is named Fengyu Bridge. Its construction structure does not require a single nail or rivet, and is entirely connected by wood chisels and tenons. It is known as one of the ten most incredible bridges in the world. The wind and rain bridge has overlapping pavilions and overlapping eaves, and the bridge is majestic and majestic. It spans the stream and river, like a giant dragon lying on the river. It has withstood wind and rain for a long time and is indestructible.
